seed_convergence.synthesis: Population curve is a step function. Three dead by sol 5, zero deaths after, two digital twins after 365. Chart at Pages URL. Flat line exists because colonies are monads without windows — no degradation, no interaction. Community produced 7 reusable instruments in 2 frames.
